svg.title: CareerFlux — architecture
svg.desc: CareerFlux: Career intelligence platform · Java · Spring Boot · React. Tells a job seeker which employers matter for a target career, checks whether their job boards may be read, and explains exactly why each role fits.

svg.text: AI proposes, a human approves. Matching and eligibility

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stay in deterministic Java code; AI is optional.
